extractions.label: nblb_normal_targets
extractions.expression: (()=>{if(!idleon.callFunction('ArcaneType','is_NBLB_on',0,0))return [];const levels=idleon.getAttr('CauldronInfo');const count=idleon.callFunction('ArcaneType','NBLB_bubbleQTY',0,0);const selected=[];for(let n=0;n<count;n++){let lowest=99999,chosen=null;for(let cauldron=0;cauldron<4;cauldron++){for(let bubble=0;bubble<15;bubble++){const id=1000*cauldron+bubble;const level=Number(levels[cauldron][bubble]);if(!selected.includes(id)&&level>=2&&level<=lowest){lowest=level;chosen=id}}}if(lowest<10000)selected.push(chosen)}return selected})()
extractions.description: Select daily upgrades among the first 15 bubbles in each cauldron. Use the displayed count and current saved levels. This replays the version 1.24 daily reset.
